title: Smart Data Models - TM Forum Open APIs - Category
description: The category resource is used to group product offerings, service and resource candidates in logical containers. Categories can contain other categories and/or product offerings, resource or service candidates. (TM Forum TMF620 Product Catalog Management 5.0.0, OpenAPI component Category; attribute names kept verbatim except the NGSI-LD reserved terms / JSON-LD keywords renamed with a tmf prefix (id, @type, @baseType, @schemaLocation, ...); deprecated attributes left out.)

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity: urn:ngsi-ld:Category:<tmfId>.

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'Category'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the original source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

tmfType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF620_ProductCatalog/blob/v5.0.0/TMF620-Product_Catalog_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Extensible/properties/@type'. Renamed from TMF '@type' (JSON-LD keyword). TMF class name of the instance: 'Category' or a sub-class / extension name. When sub-classing, this defines the sub-class Extensible name

tmfBaseType.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF620_ProductCatalog/blob/v5.0.0/TMF620-Product_Catalog_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Extensible/properties/@baseType'. Renamed from TMF '@baseType' (JSON-LD keyword). When sub-classing, this defines the super-class

tmfSchemaLocation.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF620_ProductCatalog/blob/v5.0.0/TMF620-Product_Catalog_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Extensible/properties/@schemaLocation'. Renamed from TMF '@schemaLocation' (JSON-LD keyword). A URI to a JSON-Schema file that defines additional attributes and relationships

tmfId.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF620_ProductCatalog/blob/v5.0.0/TMF620-Product_Catalog_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Addressable/properties/id'. Renamed from TMF 'id' (NGSI-LD reserved term); the NGSI-LD id is urn:ngsi-ld:Category:<tmfId>. unique identifier

isRoot.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF620_ProductCatalog/blob/v5.0.0/TMF620-Product_Catalog_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Category/properties/isRoot'. If true, this Boolean indicates that the category is a root of categories

parent.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF620_ProductCatalog/blob/v5.0.0/TMF620-Product_Catalog_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Category/properties/parent'. Reference to a category in the catalog. In TMF this is a CategoryRef object; here the NGSI-LD id of the referenced Category entity (urn:ngsi-ld:Category:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.

productOffering.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF620_ProductCatalog/blob/v5.0.0/TMF620-Product_Catalog_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Category/properties/productOffering'. List of product offerings that are referred to by the category. In TMF this is an array of ProductOfferingRef objects; here the NGSI-LD ids of the referenced ProductOffering entities (urn:ngsi-ld:ProductOffering:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.

subCategory.description: Relationship. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF620_ProductCatalog/blob/v5.0.0/TMF620-Product_Catalog_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Category/properties/subCategory'. The category resource is used to group product offerings, service and resource candidates in logical containers. Categories can contain other (sub-)categories and/or product offerings. In TMF this is an array of CategoryRef objects; here the NGSI-LD ids of the referenced Category entities (urn:ngsi-ld:Category:<tmf id>). Inline values and reference metadata (href, name, @referredType) are not kept.

validFor.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF620_ProductCatalog/blob/v5.0.0/TMF620-Product_Catalog_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Category/properties/validFor'. A period of time, either as a deadline (endDateTime only) a startDateTime only, or both

lastUpdate.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF620_ProductCatalog/blob/v5.0.0/TMF620-Product_Catalog_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Category/properties/lastUpdate'. Date and time of the last update

lifecycleStatus.description: Property. Model:'https://github.com/tmforum-apis/TMF620_ProductCatalog/blob/v5.0.0/TMF620-Product_Catalog_Management-v5.0.0.oas.yaml#/components/schemas/Category/properties/lifecycleStatus'. Used to indicate the current lifecycle status

TimePeriod.description: A period of time, either as a deadline (endDateTime only) a startDateTime only, or both

startDateTime.description: Start of the time period, using IETC-RFC-3339 format

endDateTime.description: End of the time period, using IETC-RFC-3339 format
